title: Fat Tony Debates Socrates
coreMove: Resolve a reasoning dispute by returning to exposure, consequence, and the payoff of being wrong.
sourcePressure: This chapter closes the optionality section by sharpening payoff-grounded practical judgment against abstract interrogation.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Socrates as the villain or practical judgment as anti-thinking.

sourceAnchors.name: Fat Tony
sourceAnchors.detail: the practical judge who keeps returning abstract claims to payoff and exposure
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Fat Tony does not end the argument; he asks what the argument costs.

sourceAnchors.name: Socrates
sourceAnchors.detail: the named counterweight for abstract interrogation in the chapter title
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Socrates can sharpen a question, but the answer still has to meet consequence.

hook: opening by explaining Fat Tony Debates Socrates
counterintuition: Treating Socrates as the villain or practical judgment as anti-thinking.
tryThisNow: make a pros and cons list with no exposure map
examples: reusing any prior Antifragile chapter domain
